prompt: In a photorealistic photo, a sunlit library reading room features a woman in a blue blouse sitting on a wooden chair at the left. She is looking at an open book resting on her lap. Next to her stands a tall man in a gray suit holding a stack of papers. He is pointing at a specific paragraph in the book she holds. A young girl in a yellow dress sits on the floor near the center, leaning against a large oak table. She is looking at a colorful picture book spread before her. A brown cat sleeps on the rug next to the girl, curled into a tight ball. At the right, an elderly man in a tweed jacket reads a newspaper while seated on a plush armchair. A pair of glasses rests on his nose as he focuses intently on the text. Behind him, a librarian in a green vest organizes books on a rolling cart. She is handing a thick novel to a student in a hoodie who waits patiently beside the cart. The student is looking at the librarian with anticipation. On the far wall, a clock hangs above a potted fern that adds a touch of greenery to the scene. A laptop sits closed on a nearby desk, its silver casing reflecting the ambient light. A coffee cup steams gently next to the laptop, indicating recent use. A backpack lies on the floor under the desk, slightly unzipped. There is no digital screen visible on any device. There is no modern artwork hanging on the walls.
